messages:
nina: Noticed strange linkcheck failures after the CDN rollout. Anchors sometimes jump to top of page and some images 301 -> CDN causing linkcheck to mark them as redirects. Happening on nested pages (e.g., /integrations/aws/sdk). build-bot: [linkcheck] ⚠ 8 redirects/anchor-mismatches found. Example: /integrations/aws/sdk#install -> /integrations/aws/sdk/index.html#install_1 (302) derek: Can you paste a sample of the generated HTML for that heading? Is the id different from the expected slug? nina: Generated snippet: `

Install

` but our markdown originally had `## Install`. The slugifier appended `_1`. Meanwhile the link hrefs in the sidebar and snippets are `#install`. sara: That mismatch smells like duplicate-slug resolution running after our frontmatter include/flatten step. When headings are pulled in from included partials the slug set changes and mdx ends up appending suffixes. derek: Two ways to handle: 1) canonicalize slugs using original source text before includes (preferred long-term), or 2) post-process generated HTML to map suffixed ids back to expected anchors for backwards-compat. We should also ensure SDK snippets use an absolute base_url so embedded links don't point to relative paths that turn into /integrations/assets/... ops-bot: [deploy] Note: staging nginx already has a temporary rule to rewrite /integrations/*/assets/* -> /assets/* to reduce redirect cycles. nina: For immediate unblock I ran a small post-build transform that renames ids like `install_1` -> `install` when `#install` exists in incoming links. Script I used (one-liner): ```bash find site -name '*.html' -exec perl -0777 -pe "s/id=\"([a-z0-9_-]+)_\d+\"/id=\"$1\"/g" -i {} + ``` derek: That's OK as a short-term mitigation but please add a unit test so linkcheck doesn't regress. I opened a PR to add tests + a cleaner template change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/724 sara: PR looks good. I suggested switching mkdocs config to use absolute_url filter in the theme (helps assets and anchors). Also included a small python linkcheck test that requests anchors with both desktop and mobile UA strings. build-bot: [ci] Job 8123: linkcheck failed (before the post-build patch). After patch job 8135: linkcheck passed on staging. ops-bot: We've scheduled DOCS-350 to track the theme/template fix and DOCS-351 for SDK snippet base_url normalization. nina: Merging the post-build patch to avoid blocking the prod deploy; long-term fixes tracked in the tickets. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
